steps.code:
# Parse the songs to archive from the file content
import re

file_text = file_content['content']
songs_to_archive = []
for line in file_text.split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: "- Song Title by Artist"
        song_info = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " to get title and artist
        parts = song_info.split(' by ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            artist = parts[1].strip()
            songs_to_archive.append({'title': title, 'artist': artist})

print(f"Found {len(songs_to_archive)} songs to archive")
print(songs_to_archive)
